added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run baseline_suite and after_suite id sets: 0 added, 5 removed, exactly the five ids in scope; the head set is corroborated by gate-head.log while the baseline set rests on the run record alone because gate-main.log is truncated and no preserved artefact carries its id list.

findings.text: blocking: the log the manifest cites as the baseline arm is truncated at 77% of the suite with no summary line, no EXIT= line and zero FAILED lines, and its header names tree main2 at revision 282260d6c while baseline_suite declares tree gate/main at 352e0096a; no preserved artefact carries the 71 baseline failure ids at all — the run stream and the harness transcript hold the "71 failed, 8452 passed" summary but at most one FAILED id per record — so the id list behind the "zero added" claim cannot be read from any file a later reader can open; the head arm is corroborated line for line and both revisions carry a byte-identical export.py, so the repair is to re-record or re-point the baseline arm, not to re-measure.

non-blocking: the root is installed at this one caller instead of at the owner that needs it — classify_sourceless_standard_names reads foundation.get_services() at graph_supersession.py:3023-3124 — so any other entrypoint reaching the storage layer without importing graph_ops still refuses; the worker recorded this under outside_scope and the module is outside its fence.

non-blocking: the three doubles identify the audit's count reads by Cypher substring ("AS total", then "AS names" with "AS projections"), so renaming an alias in graph_supersession.py turns the doubles into failing reads rather than into a silent wrong answer; loud, but the coupling belongs to the audit's query text rather than to a shared fixture.

item_verdicts.goal: The node's goal was to settle the five C4 export ids and name a fix per id; imas_codex/standard_names/export.py:3029-3039 now installs the composition root before the source audit, and docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-red-export-accounting.html carries one line per id classifying four as code fixes and the refusal as already writing .export_report.json.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read at the reviewed run directory; it records both gate arms as JSON, a negative control log, the outside-scope pair, and six rubric lines, but its baseline_suite declares completed true for a log that has no summary line.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The manifest grants export.py, the three test files and the landing fragment; git diff b14dec11..60e41670f changes exactly those five paths and nothing else.

justifications.durability: importing imas_codex.standard_names.export leaves graph_foundation._services uninitialised (verified on the head tree), so removing the call at export.py:3039 makes test_export_empty_refusal.py:71 and both manifest-generability assertions raise "Graph services are not wired"; the added lines themselves assert nothing, so what guards the change is those pre-existing assertions.
justifications.evidence: gate-head.log:1667-1668 carries "66 failed, 8457 passed" and EXIT=1 matching the manifest's 66 ids, but gate-main.log has only 116 lines, no summary, no EXIT= and zero FAILED lines, and its header names revision 282260d6c/tree main2 while baseline_suite declares 352e0096a/tree gate/main.
justifications.fit: the fix uses a lazy in-function import and one call, matching export.py's existing lazy-import idiom at :3027-3031, and the added comments state the mechanism without a plan or ticket reference.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/standard_names/export.py:3039 calls graph_foundation.services_for_call() before classify_sourceless_standard_names, which is exactly the seam whose absence made every export refuse, and the fragment records the decision per id.
justifications.reuse: the capability search over graph_store found the owner imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_foundation.py:80 services_for_call, which the change calls rather than re-implementing; the test count rows mirror the real aliases at graph_supersession.py:3035 and :3095.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat b14dec11..60e41670f lists only the four granted code/test paths and the granted fragment, with no change outside the fence.
